=== diw
--- before
foo b¦ar baz
--- keys
diw
--- after
foo ¦ baz

=== daw
--- before
foo b¦ar baz
--- keys
daw
--- after
foo ¦baz

=== daw last word
--- before
foo b¦ar
--- keys
daw
--- after
fo¦o

=== daw on space
--- before
foo¦ bar baz
--- keys
daw
--- after
foo¦ baz

=== diw on space
--- before
foo ¦  bar
--- keys
diw
--- after
foo¦bar

=== d2aw
--- before
¦one two three four
--- keys
d2aw
--- after
¦three four

=== d3iw
--- before
¦one two three
--- keys
d3iw
--- after
¦ three

=== ciw
--- before
foo b¦ar baz
--- keys
ciwX<Esc>
--- after
foo ¦X baz

=== caw
--- before
foo b¦ar baz
--- keys
cawX<Esc>
--- after
foo ¦Xbaz

=== yiw +reg
--- before
foo b¦ar baz
--- keys
yiw
--- after
foo ¦bar baz
[reg v] "bar"

=== diW
--- before
x a.b¦.c y
--- keys
diW
--- after
x ¦ y

=== daW
--- before
x a.b¦.c y
--- keys
daW
--- after
x ¦y

=== diw punctuation
--- before
foo.b¦ar(x)
--- keys
diw
--- after
foo.¦(x)

=== daw indented
--- before
    fo¦o bar
--- keys
daw
--- after
    ¦bar

=== daw at end of sentence
--- before
one two thr¦ee.
--- keys
daw
--- after
one two¦.

=== dis

--- keys
dis
--- after

--- after
